content.value_statement: Outreach teams need consistent, personal messages without losing track of replies and terms. This skill creates tailored outreach, follow-ups, negotiation guidance, and a practical pipeline view.
actual_capabilities: Collect campaign, audience, budget, deliverable, and timeline details for each target.
Draft personalized outreach in short DM, email, and formal management versions.
Build a four-touch follow-up cadence with timing and a clear stop point.
Create negotiation scripts for rate, scope, exclusivity, and timing objections.
Organize target status, next actions, conversion metrics, and closed outcomes.
Apply cold-outreach rules that require verified claims and links.
limitations: It drafts outreach but does not send email, direct messages, or schedule messages.
It relies on information supplied by the user or an available approved data source.
It cannot verify a target’s contact details, rates, or content claims without reliable input.
It does not replace legal review for signed agreements or disclosure requirements.

use_cases.title: Launch a creator campaign
use_cases.description: Prepare individualized messages and a follow-up schedule for a new product launch.

use_cases.title: Re-engage past partners
use_cases.description: Create a respectful re-engagement pitch using known campaign history and updated terms.

use_cases.title: Handle budget negotiations
use_cases.description: Compare requested rates with budget and prepare scope-adjustment responses.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a first outreach message
prompt_templates.prompt: Write a short outreach DM to @[creator] for [product]. Their niche is [niche]. Offer [compensation] for [deliverables]. Use a soft call to action.

prompt_templates.title: Build a follow-up sequence
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a four-touch follow-up sequence for @[creator] after a first pitch about [campaign]. Use Day 0, Day 4, Day 8, and Day 14. Stop after Day 21.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a negotiation response
prompt_templates.prompt: The creator requested $[ask], but our budget is $[budget]. Draft respectful options for reducing scope, adding future value, or declining clearly.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a complete outreach pipeline
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an outreach pipeline for these targets: [list]. Include personalization points, message status, next action, follow-up date, budget, and top objections.

output_examples.input: Write outreach for an eco-lifestyle creator with 45,000 Instagram followers for an organic skincare launch.
output: Personalization point: Reference the creator’s zero-waste bathroom content.
Primary message: A concise collaboration invitation with product, compensation, and creative-freedom details.
Next action: Send a short follow-up after four days if there is no reply.

output_examples.input: A creator wants $2,000, but the campaign budget is $1,200.
output: Offer a smaller deliverable package at $1,200.
Offer an alternative package with affiliate compensation or a future campaign option.
Use a respectful response that invites the creator to choose an option.

best_practices: Use real, specific details from the creator’s work and verify every claim before sending.
Keep the first contact short and use a low-commitment call to action.
Record each reply, next action, and agreed term in the outreach pipeline.
anti_patterns: Do not invent testimonials, performance figures, content references, or URLs.
Do not send repeated follow-ups after the defined cadence ends.
Do not treat a draft as permission to contact someone without human review.

faq.question: Does this skill send messages?
faq.answer: No. It prepares messages, sequences, negotiation guidance, and pipeline records for your review.

faq.question: Can it write for email and direct messages?
faq.answer: Yes. It can prepare short direct-message versions and more formal email or management versions.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the target, platform, niche, campaign, compensation, deliverables, budget, and timeline.

faq.question: Can it negotiate creator rates?
faq.answer: It can draft negotiation options and responses. A human should approve final commercial terms.

faq.question: Can it research creators automatically?
faq.answer: No. Supply verified target information or connect an approved source before using it for personalization.

faq.question: How many follow-ups does it recommend?
faq.answer: It recommends a four-touch cadence, then archiving the contact after Day 21 if there is no response.
